explanation: Expand around every character and every gap between characters. Track the longest palindrome and choose the earliest starting index when lengths tie.
timeComplexity: O(n squared) time for n characters.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space excluding the returned substring.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 Python algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
